personality_one_liner: A refined, editorial-driven floral marketplace that treats every bouquet like a piece of art.

spacing.rule: Generous magazine-like vertical breathing room. Minimal structural borders, prefer negative space for grouping.

do's: Use frosted glass on the bottom tab bar
Apply to sticky headers over scrolling floral imagery
Use as a backdrop for featured bouquet cards floating over botanical photos
dont's: Avoid on form inputs or dense admin list rows
Do not over-stack; max 2 glass surfaces per screen

screens.name: Customer Home
screens.purpose: Immersive discovery of curated bouquets and local flower shops.

states.loading: Centered soft pulse of the brand mark.
states.empty: Elegant line-art vase illustration: 'No fresh blooms found in this area.'
states.error: Subtle text message with a clean retry button.

screens.layout: Full-bleed hero image of a featured arrangement with a gradient-to-dark scrim. Horizontal scroll for 'Curated Collections'. Full-width editorial cards for 'Local Shops'. Typography drives hierarchy.

screens.name: Bouquet Studio (3D)
screens.purpose: Custom interactive 3D arrangement studio using expo-gl/three.

states.loading: Skeleton UI around the 3D canvas with a 'Preparing your studio...' loader.
states.empty: N/A - Defaults to a blank vase in the 3D scene.
states.error: Fallback to 2D illustration if WebGL fails, with 'Unable to load 3D studio'.

screens.layout: Screen split: Top 60% is full-bleed 3D canvas (expo-gl). Bottom 40% is a bottom-sheet style surface containing tabs for Flowers, Fillers, and Vases with horizontal selection lists. Sticky 'Add to Cart' button.

screens.name: Order Tracking (Customer)

states.error: Error loading map message with retry option.

screens.layout: Full-screen Google Map. Floating glassmorphic card at the top for status ('Out for Delivery'). Bottom sheet displaying driver details, ETA, and a primary CTA to contact the driver.

screens.name: Flower Shop Owner Dashboard
screens.purpose: Manage inventory, incoming orders, and daily sales metrics.

states.empty: 'No orders yet today.' with a soft brand-tinted empty state illustration.
states.error: Clean error banner at the top of the screen.

screens.layout: Editorial but utilitarian. Top section features large typography metrics (e.g., '12 Pending Orders'). Below are segmented tabs (Orders, Inventory) leading into clean, borderless list rows.

screens.name: Admin Overview
screens.layout: Dense but airy. Grid of metric cards at the top. Below, a tabbed interface for Users, Shops, and Products utilizing single-column lists with subtle dividers and prominent status badges.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure strict adherence to the Editorial Mobile LIGHT personality: rely on generous whitespace and typography for grouping rather than heavy cards or shadows.
Use Cormorant Garamond for all primary headings and Geist for body, UI labels, and data points.

The 3D Bouquet Studio using expo-gl/three MUST handle the canvas efficiently. The 3D scene should occupy the upper portion of the screen with a frosted glass or clean solid surface secondary sheet layered over the bottom for the selection UI.
For the Customer app, utilize the gradient-to-dark scrim pattern (Layer 0 image -> Layer 1 vertical gradient -> Layer 2 text) for all hero imagery to ensure readability.
Distinct Role Routing: Set up the router to handle /customer, /owner, and /admin namespaces clearly. Each should have its own dedicated _layout with distinct bottom tabs.
Implement Google Maps for delivery tracking in the customer order flow, utilizing a floating glass card for status and a bottom sheet for driver details.
Provide clear data-testID attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs) for reliable testing.
No indigo, blue, or purple colors. Rely strictly on the defined pastel ivory/blush base and rich burgundy brand accents.
